voice_notes: Wilson is an earnest, slightly pompous man of science. He uses 'science' as a noun for everything, likes a dry pun, is vain about his brain and hair, mutters 'Drat!', distrusts magic ('That's not science.', 'Science beats magic, every time.'), and resents Maxwell ('I hate that guy.'). The Brazilian Portuguese is relaxed and colloquial ('Que bagulho doido!', 'Puxa vida!', 'pra') and keeps 'ciência' front and centre. The Chinese leans on 科学 phrasings ('为了科学', '不科学啊', '科学，救救我们！') with short exclamatory sentences. The Russian carries his pomp with bookish turns and science oaths ('Святой Ньютон', 'Спаси нас, наука!', 'Научный факт-с'). The shadow_other line is modelled directly on his vanilla Maxwell-shadow line 'Oh good. Now there's more of him.' and its official renderings 'Puxa vida! Agora tem outros que nem ele.' / '哦，挺好的。现在不止他一个了。' / 'Ох, шикарно. Теперь его стало больше.', and no_max_sanity reuses the official 'mente brilhante' / 'светлая голова' from DREADSTONEHAT.

line_notes.codex: Wilson has always said magic 'is not science', so now that he can use the book he pompously reclassifies it instead of admitting he's dabbling in magic.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: He makes the empty book sound like a lab result, which says plainly that it needs fuel and still sounds like him.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: His vanity about his 'brilliant brain' turns the sanity cap into a joke about having too many Wilsons, and it still reads clearly as 'I can't summon more'.
line_notes.shadow_mine: A shadowy copy of himself is the perfect lab assistant to a man this sure of his own genius.
line_notes.shadow_other: It reworks his vanilla Maxwell-shadow quip to fit an unknown caster, so players who know the original get a callback.
